policy: References informed colony form, polyp proportions, tentacle count and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source. The trade name flowerpot coral spans several Goniopora species, so the asset is labelled at genus level.

sources.title: Goniopora de Blainville, 1830 taxon record (genus, Poritidae, Scleractinia)

referenceGradeRationale: Genus-level morphology (dome colony, elongate polyps, 24 tentacles, calice size, colour classes) is well described in authoritative taxonomic sources and openly licensed photographs show side and top views; exact stalk length to disc ratios vary by species and were set from those genus descriptions rather than a calibrated specimen.
